relations.subject: Trijang Rinpoche
relations.evidence: The Third Trijang Rinpoche, Lobsang Yeshe Tenzin Gyatso (1901–1981) was a Gelugpa Lama and a direct disciple of Pabongkhapa Déchen Nyingpo.

relations.subject: 14th Dalai Lama
relations.evidence: In 1941, Trijang Rinpoche was appointed Assistant Tutor to the 14th Dalai Lama, and thereafter helped the Senior Tutor Ling Rinpoche in educating him

relations.subject: Zong Rinpoche
relations.evidence: He was also a lama of many Gelug lamas who taught in the West including Zong Rinpoche, Geshe Rabten, Lama Yeshe, Kelsang Gyatso, and Lama Zopa Rinpoche.

relations.subject: Trijang Rinpoche
relations.evidence: In 1908, he received Kalachakra initiation from Serkong Rinpoche, as well as empowerments into Manjusri, Avalokiteśvara and Vajrapani.

relations.subject: Trijang Rinpoche
relations.evidence: He received the "Empowerment into the Six Ways to Revolve the Chakras of Heruka"... from Khyenrab Yonten Gyatso, the 88th Ganden Tripa, in 1915, aged 14.

relations.subject: Trijang Rinpoche
relations.evidence: He was admitted to the Upper Tantric College, Gyuto, in 1919, where he studied the Root Tantra of Heruka and its commentary by Je Tsongkhapa

relations.subject: Trijang Rinpoche
relations.role: junior tutor of the 14th Dalai Lama
relations.evidence: He succeeded Ling Rinpoche as the junior tutor of the 14th Dalai Lama when the Dalai Lama was nineteen years old.
